original_test_intent: Measure sustained bandwidth of the approved Ethernet and/or InfiniBand interface with the correct peer tool and compare it to the authoritative specification, explicitly covering the required1G LAN case.
original_method: Engineering selects applicable Ethernet/IB branches and signed profiles; operator validates isolated cabling/peer; agent runs tracked iperf3 or ib_write_bw pairs, captures bidirectional/branch-appropriate throughput and errors, then cleans up only owned processes.
manual_activity: Engineer approves applicable Ethernet/IB matrix, threshold and traffic limits; operator validates peer/cabling/recovery; agent may run only signed tracked profiles.
required_inputs: Per-port NIC type/interface/PCI mapping and decision whether Ethernet, IB or both branches apply
Authoritative SPEC throughput thresholds/tolerance for1G and any other rates
Compatible peer identity/path/addressing/cabling and independent management access
iperf3 or perftest/ib_write_bw versions, direction, streams/QP, MTU/message size and duration
Traffic isolation, CPU/NUMA affinity policy, monitoring, tracked cleanup, abort/recovery and invalid-run rules
safety_requirements: Verify test and management paths are distinct and peer is correct
Track exact server/client PIDs and never broad-kill processes
Stop on management/BMC impact, route/link drift, congestion beyond scope, errors, peer loss or instability
No automatic rerun, reboot or network reconfiguration
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete baseline and run only approved Ethernet/IB peer profiles
Capture both-end throughput/errors/status plus system/network health and clean only owned processes
Do not choose branch/threshold, saturate shared links, broad-kill or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve Ethernet-versus-IB coverage and criteria scope
Review normalized results and issue verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat each port/tool/direction as a separately identified profile with synchronized peer evidence and a normalized threshold calculation.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Throughput depends on protocol overhead, streams, CPU/NUMA affinity, MTU, PCIe link and peer bottlenecks; link rate is not the same as achievable application bandwidth.

Exact client/server commands and tracked PIDs on both ends

SPEC calculation, traffic-impact/cleanup/recovery/invalid-run disposition and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure names separate Ethernet and InfiniBand tests, but Criteria provide only a generic SPEC check and explicit1G LAN confirmation, leaving whether IB is mandatory and its threshold/profile undefined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The branch matrix, peer, tools and thresholds can be supplied; static review is complete and the decision does not block later cases.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row51 Wistron-Networking-00034-V003: decide whether Ethernet iPerf, InfiniBand ib_write_bw or both branches are mandatory for installed ports despite Criteria only naming1G LAN; provide exact port/PCI/interface/GID and peer topology, authoritative throughput thresholds/tolerance, iperf3/perftest versions, direction/streams/QP/message-size/MTU/duration/CPU-NUMA profile, isolated non-management path, health aborts, tracked PID cleanup, recovery and invalid-run policy. Ethernet-only DeepSeek output must not cover an applicable IB branch.

review_improvement: Preserves both source branches while preventing a generic1G iperf run from being counted against undefined IB or SPEC requirements.
independent_technical_reasoning: Ethernet iperf3 measures socket traffic, whereas `ib_write_bw` measures RDMA writes with different queue, message-size and GID/MTU semantics. Results are not interchangeable and both can be limited by peer CPU/PCIe/topology rather than the NIC. Acceptance must bind each measured profile to its interface technology, peer and overhead-aware threshold.
